name: The majority voted against a [One Nation amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-04-01.46.1) to the usual second reading motion, which is "*that the bill be read a second time*". Had it been successful, this amendment would have added the text below. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add ", but the Senate calls on the Government to support hospitality venues struggling under the growing burden of government regulation and growth in overheads by eliminating alcohol excise duty on any alcoholic product sold for consumption on-premises in a hospitality venue".*
